name: Naman Parikh
tagline: I build agent-native software: tools that agents use, built with agents, that improve themselves.
role: Product Manager 2, Agent TPM at Microsoft (Azure HPC and AI)
pitch: I believe the next era of AI will be defined not just by frontier model intelligence, but by the real economic value it creates. I measure it as **return on watts = tokens per watt × real value per token**, and my entire career has been about maximizing it.
Tokens per watt is what the hardware makes. Real value per token is what each token earns for the person who uses it.
now: Building agent employees: agents with their own identity, skills and memory, which any coding agent can install, and which propose their own improvements for a person to review.
Measuring every system by return on watts: how many tokens a watt makes, and how much real value each token carries.
Open-sourcing the parts as I go, each one an agent employee you can install in one step.

start.armory: Find and rank the parts of an agent's harness
start.agentgrid: Run many coding agents at once
start.agentdial: Give an agent a phone number, an inbox and chat
start.agentbench: Score your agent setup out of 100
start.claude-harness: Start from a complete Claude Code setup
